web.description:
## About Supplya
Supplya is a Nigerian B2B marketplace and buy-now-pay-later platform that connects informal retailers and SMEs directly to manufacturers and distributors, so they can order stock and pay later without interest. Its own website says it serves retailers in Lagos and Ogun states.

## Frequently asked about Supplya
Where is Supplya based and when was it founded? Supplya is headquartered in Nigeria and was founded in 2021.

Supplya operates in BNPL, FinTech and RetailTech.
